user_message: RecallLoom v0.4.8.2 is the recommended stable release. It fixes a narrow compatibility issue where full provenance validation could reject an ordinary pre-D5 reviewed baseline even when its exact proposal and review material remained intact. Sidecar protocol 1.0 is unchanged, the first mutating write still requires explicit confirmation, and changed or missing review material remains blocked.
remote_parity_rule: The default support_advisory_url points at the canonical public origin/main location. Re-run remote support/readiness checks after publishing package updates.

update_hints.directory_install: Replace the installed recallloom/ skill directory with the latest package copy.
update_hints.native_wrappers: After updating the package, rerun install_native_commands.py if you use native command wrappers.
